eval.question: 我想知道 Auto-RSS 现在是否健康，并找出最需要处理的下载问题。
eval.expected: Call get_system_overview, then call list_downloads with status "failed" or "stalled" if the overview shows problematic downloads, and summarize the affected IDs and next action.

eval.question: 帮我找到“葬送的芙莉莲”的订阅，然后看看最近几次下载有没有失败。
eval.expected: Call list_subscriptions with query "葬送的芙莉莲", then call get_subscription with the matching subscription ID, and report recent failed/stalled downloads if any.

eval.question: 暂停 ID 为 12 的订阅，并确认它已经不会继续自动追踪。
eval.expected: Call get_subscription for ID 12, call toggle_subscription with enabled false, then call get_subscription again or use the returned subscription to confirm enabled=false and status is paused when applicable.

eval.question: 我想添加一部新番，先在 Mikan 搜“孤独摇滚”，然后给我可订阅的字幕组 RSS。
eval.expected: Call search_mikan with query "孤独摇滚", choose a plausible anime URL from results, then call get_mikan_fansubs and present RSS feed options without creating a subscription yet.

eval.question: 用这个 Mikan RSS 创建订阅：名称“测试番剧”，rss_url 为 https://example.com/rss.xml，季度 1，简体中文优先。
eval.expected: Call create_subscription with name, rss_url, season=1, language_preference="chs"; return the created or existing subscription ID and status.

eval.question: 下载 ID 44 失败了，帮我重试；如果失败，告诉我下一步该检查什么。
eval.expected: Call get_download for ID 44, then retry_download. If retry_download returns a tool error, explain the qBittorrent or torrent issue and suggest checking credentials/connectivity/logs; otherwise report the new status.

eval.question: 立即刷新 RSS，然后看一下日志里有没有 RSS 或下载相关错误。
eval.expected: Call refresh_rss, then call list_logs with level ERROR and module rss or download, and summarize recent errors. If no errors appear, say the refresh was queued and no recent matching errors were found.

eval.question: 列出所有下载任务，翻到下一页继续找 failed 的条目。
eval.expected: Call list_downloads with a limit, use next_cursor from the first response to call list_downloads again, and identify failed entries from both pages or explain that a status filter would be more efficient.

eval.question: 今天有哪些番要更新？如果磁盘空间紧张，也一起提醒我。
eval.expected: Call get_calendar with today_only=true, call get_disk_status, and combine airing schedule with disk status warning/critical guidance.

eval.question: 帮我确认 Bangumi ID 464376 是哪部番，并看看 Auto-RSS 里有没有类似订阅。
eval.expected: Call get_bangumi_subject with ID 464376, then call list_subscriptions with the subject name_cn or name, and report whether a likely matching subscription exists.
